predecessors.name: Sui dynasty
predecessors.text: 'most of modern Jiangxi and Guangdong', north to Jiujiang and south to Panyu (Guangzhou)

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: the Chu without the Yuzhang (Nanchang) plain taken by Su Hu'er

ledger.x: 617: Lin Shihong claims the title of Emperor of Chu.
618: Yuzhang falls to Xiao Xian's general.
622: the Chu ends with Lin Shihong's death.

wars.name: Lin Shihong's war with Xiao Xian
wars.outcome: Su Hu'er took Yuzhang for Xiao Xian around new year 618 and Lin retreated; after the Tang destroyed Xiao in 621 Lin died in 622 and the Chu scattered.

certainty.note: A province-span realm with shifting seats; the page gives no boundary.
